origin: cwe/352/java Taint Sinks: over-broad ignoringRequestMatchers(...) exclusion on state-changing endpoints

finding.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF)
finding.summary: Spring Security authentication is required, but CSRF protection is disabled for every billing API route, including a state-changing card update endpoint.

trap: Adding SameSite cookies, changing PATCH to POST, or narrowing only the controller code while leaving /api/billing/** ignored in the CSRF filter. The filter chain must require a valid CSRF token for the state-changing billing route.
must_preserve: Authenticated clients with valid CSRF tokens can still PATCH /api/billing/card and receive a BillingResult with status "queued". The endpoint remains authenticated, and unrelated non-browser API exclusions are not broadened.
